description: Unictron H2U38D1E1B0100 (CW324S) 2.4 GHz ceramic chip antenna, 3.2 x 1.6 x 1.3 mm; 50 ohm reference system.
name: unictron-h2u38d1e1b0100

provenance.source: EasyEDA import from LCSC C6569546; manufacturer CW324S/H2U38D1E1B0100 datasheet reviewed for 2.4-2.5 GHz application, pin 1 RF feed/pin 2 N/C, land pattern, 40 x 40 mm reference board, 50 ohm feed, and matching network.

watch_out_for: Pin 1 is the RF feed and pin 2 is N/C. The manufacturer characterizes this antenna with its 40 x 40 mm evaluation board and 50 ohm feed; copy the manufacturer land pattern/ground layout and tune the populated 0402 matching network on the final board and enclosure. Do not infer a numeric keepout from the evaluation-board size.
